text:
maria: FYI seeing a 95/99th pct latency spike starting ~1860012000 on prod-runtime, coincides with a burst of very long prompts from a single tenant (acme-forms). GPU util stayed ~40% while latencies jumped :eyes:
kevin: looking... any profile traces? which scheduler/runtime flags were active?
maria: scheduler v2.3.1 with adaptive-prefetcher=on, micro-batching=auto. pasted quick logs below.
kevin: initial hunch: prefetcher attempted aggressive KV pre-warm for long prompts and triggered kvcache churn -> kernel selection oscillation. can you paste the log snippet?
maria: ```
[2026-03-17T11:17:03Z] prefetcher: request=tenant/acme-forms id=0x7f kvcache_prefetch=128 entries
[2026-03-17T11:17:03Z] kvcache: eviction=LRU evicted=120 reason=capacity
[2026-03-17T11:17:03Z] kernel-select: chosen=fast-attn seq=64 -> fallback=matmul seq=512
[2026-03-17T11:17:04Z] scheduler: micro-batch-window shrunk 16 -> 2 due to latency SLO
```
kevin: that kernel-select jumping between fast-attn and matmul is suspicious. rapid seq-length variance can make the chooser thrash and cause throughput collapse.
raj: I also see repeated streaming session opens from that tenant's toolchain webhook — looks like a tool-calling loop triggering new streams instead of reusing sessions which increases concurrent KV pressure.
ingrid: can someone run a quick perf capture on the worker that served that tenant (worker-21)? I want to see lock contention on the KV path.
maria: ran a quick nsys capture and generated a flamegraph — ~40% of time in einsum kernels blocked on kvcache lock; attaching gist: https://redwood.gists/frag1 (short capture).
sre-bot: incident created INC-2026-83 assigned to eng-runtime and oncall.
kevin: quick mitigation plan: 1) toggle adaptive-prefetcher off for prod-pool-3, 2) increase micro-batch-window to 32 for that pool, 3) rate-limit per-tenant prefetch budget. I'll roll a hotfix.
deploy-bot: rollout started for runtime-config v2.3.1-hotfix5 -> prod-pool-3 (3 nodes).
maria: applied config change to pool prod-pool-3, observing metrics now.
kevin: post-patch: 99th pct latency returned to baseline within ~30s and queue depth normalized. appears prefetcher-induced kvcache churn forced kernel mispredictions and micro-batch collapse.
raj: filed follow-up PERF ticket PERF-1209: "Add hysteresis and cost model to kernel chooser; add per-tenant prefetch budgets; expose kvcache prefetch metrics."
ingrid: + add streaming session reuse metric and detect toolcall loops that open new sessions per tool event.
maria: I'll draft a short runbook for oncall: how to identify prefetcher misfires, quick toggles, and rollback steps. scheduling a retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks all — good catch on the streaming/tool loop correlation.
